title: Chrissy Teigen's High Slit Tom Ford Gown Gets Bold Upgrade for Grammys - NewsBreak
text:
By Mehak Walia ,
2 hours ago Photo Credit: Axelle / Bauer-Griffin / FilmMagic via Getty Red carpet drama is expected at the Grammys , and the 2026 version definitely delivered a major dose. However, it was Chrissy Teigen who gave her look extra bite, leaving everyone absolutely speechless.
Wearing a high-slit Tom Ford gown, she left onlookers gushing and gasping. Meanwhile, what made this look extra special was the fact that she added her own twist with chic accessories. This turned her outfit into something far more headline-worthy.
Chrissy Teigen’s Tom Ford gown with high slit also features bold neckline for Grammys For this star-studded occasion, Chrissy Teigen opted for a simply incomparable, icy-blue floor-length gown that worked wonders for her frame. It also looked amazing against her flawless complexion. The soft and smooth satin fabric also made this a comfortably chic choice. The applause-worthy look also featured a deep plunging neckline with very sleek straps, which gave it a barely there shoulder line.
Its fitted bodice and free-flowing skirt made this look a force to be reckoned with. Furthermore, the high slit on the side added a fiery twist, while also adding movement and drama. It helped Teigen show off her oh-so-toned legs. The minimal and uncluttered silhouette made this a simple yet spectacular look to watch out for. Teigen also completed the outfit with a personalized twist, choosing some fabulous accessories.
She added some sparkle to the loom with delicate, layered necklaces of different lengths. These were the perfect choice to highlight the plunging neckline. Instead of crowding her wrists with bracelets, she just went with a stylish ring for this one. Chrissy Teigen also rounded out the look with gold metallic strappy heels, which looked great with the accessories. Even her beautifully wavy hairstyle with a side parting and her flawless makeup look, with dramatic eyes and a nude lip shade, were just great.
The post Chrissy Teigen’s High Slit Tom Ford Gown Gets Bold Upgrade for Grammys appeared first on theFashionSpot .
